## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass

- [ ] For a change to picks or the model: the effect on the track record is stated (hit rate, ROI, forecast error)
- [ ] For a new or changed data source: its failure is handled (breaker, carry-forward) and it appears on the Sources page
